iceberg.finding: DuckDB INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE all commit and Databricks reads back exactly the expected rows -- on a table Databricks has only appended to. Once Databricks itself runs UPDATE/DELETE (writing Iceberg v3 deletion vectors), DuckDB's default reader rejects the table: Puffin file 's3://experiment-bucket/<path>' has invalid trailing magic. Older versions of DuckDB wrote deletion vector files as bare blobs. To read those files, run "SET iceberg_unsafe_skip_puffin_verification = true". With iceberg_unsafe_skip_puffin_verification, the same DML succeeds and Databricks reads the expected rows.
